Sugar Shack – Old Florida Charm with Private Heated Pool, Hot Tub & Golf Cart!

6-SEATER GOLF CART INCLUDED!
(A $150+/day value—yours free!)

Welcome to Sugar Shack—a beautifully restored Old Florida-style home in the heart of Seagrove Beach, just a 5-minute walk to the sugar-white sands of 30A. With a private heated pool, hot tub, 6 bikes, multiple living spaces, and room for up to 12 guests, this home is perfect for families and large groups looking for space, charm, and privacy.

⸻

🏖 What’s Included:
• Private heated pool (heating optional for $50/night Oct–Apr)
• Hot tub
• 2024 6-seater golf cart
• 6 bikes for exploring 30A
• 12 beach chairs, 12 towels, 1 umbrella, and a cooler
• BBQ grill + outdoor shower
• Screened-in porch & koi pond
• Plenty of porches & outdoor lounging areas

⸻

🛏 Flexible Layout – Sleeps 12 Comfortably:

The home is split into three separate living areas, ideal for multi-family vacations or guests wanting space to spread out.

🏡 Main House (Sleeps 6):
• Bedroom 1: King bed + en suite bath (clawfoot tub + separate shower)
• Bedroom 2: King bed
• Bedroom 3: Twin daybed + twin trundle (connected to Bedroom 2 by barn door)
• Full hallway bathroom (tub/shower combo)
• Gourmet kitchen, dining room, and fireplace in living room

🛋️ Private Guest Suite (Sleeps 4):
• Separate entrance
• Bedroom 4: 2 queen beds (up spiral staircase – note: stairs are steep)
• Downstairs: Full kitchen, dining space, full bathroom with shower

🛏 Detached Studio (Sleeps 2):
• Bedroom 5: 2 twin beds
• Note: This space does not have its own bathroom—guests use main house facilities.

⸻

🧑‍🍳 Kitchen Features:
• 2 fully equipped kitchens
• Custom cabinetry + marble countertops
• Stainless steel appliances
• Coffee maker, blender, and all cooking essentials

⸻

🍹 Outdoor Living:
• Screened porch for shaded relaxation
• Hot tub under the stars
• Multiple dining and lounge spaces
• Outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach
• Beautifully landscaped yard with koi pond

⸻

📍 Walk or Cart to the Beach:

Just a 5-minute stroll or quick golf cart ride down Somerset Bridge Road to the beach access!
Close to Seaside, WaterColor, and your favorite 30A spots.
**** Please be informed that new construction is underway next door, which may result in construction workers and noise during your stay. The construction project is expected to be completed in May 2026, with exterior work anticipated to be finished by the end of March 2026. If you require further details, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Note that the time frames are subject to change due to weather conditions and the need for permits.****.
⸻

🍽️ Local Favorites Nearby:
• Cafe Thirty-A (walking distance)
• Surfing Deer, Goatfeathers, Angelina’s Pizza, Perfect Pig
• The Hub for food, drinks & live music
• Old Florida Fish House & Seagrove Village Market for local flair

⸻

✔️ Details to Know:
• Check-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 9:00 AM
• Starter supplies provided: TP, paper towels, trash bags, detergent
• No smoking anywhere on property
• Max occupancy strictly enforced
• Primary renter must be 25+, or accompanied by a parent/legal guardian
• No street parking – driveway fits 3 vehicles
• Golf cart must remain within WaterColor (west) and Rosemary Beach (east)
• Guests are responsible for keeping the golf cart charged
• Pool heat must be requested 48 hours in advance and paid before arrival ($50/night; Oct–Apr)
• Use of golf cart, pool, hot tub, or other amenities is at guest’s own risk

⸻

Whether you’re relaxing by the pool, biking to the beach, or sharing meals on the screened porch, Sugar Shack is the perfect place to enjoy Seagrove’s classic charm and laid-back luxury.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Thanks so much for the kind and thoughtful feedback! We’re really glad you enjoyed the hot tub, the easy beach access, and the convenience of the nearby gas station. It’s great to hear the golf cart, bikes, and beach gear made getting around and enjoying the area even easier.

We also appreciate you noticing the little things, from the well-stocked kitchen and household essentials to the bedding, decor, and outdoor spaces. The unique bedroom layout is something we love about the home, so we’re happy it added to your experience.
